```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(conflicted)
library(janitor)
library(kableExtra)
library(plotly)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(htmltools)
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(maps)
library(khroma)

conflicted::conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflicted::conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(plotly::layout)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    comment = "#>",
    message = FALSE,
    warning = FALSE,
    cache = FALSE,
    echo = TRUE,
    eval = TRUE,
    tidy.opts = list(width.cutoff = 100),
    tidy = FALSE,
    fig.align = "center"
)

ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_minimal())
ggplot2::theme_update(panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())
```

# Week 31: Australian Biodiversity, Tourism & Climate

```{r load-data}
occurrences <- read_csv("data/occurrences.csv")
tourism <- read_csv("data/tourism.csv")
weather <- read_csv("data/weather.csv")

# Paul Tol color palette for species groups (khroma bright)
species_colors <- c(
    "Glowworm" = "#228833", # Paul Tol Green
    "Gouldian finch" = "#EE6677", # Paul Tol Red/Pink
    "Manta ray" = "#4477AA", # Paul Tol Blue
    "Orchid" = "#AA3377" # Paul Tol Purple
)

# Paul Tol color palette for tourism purpose
purpose_colors <- c(
    "Holiday"  = "#4477AA", # Paul Tol Blue
    "Business" = "#EE6677" # Paul Tol Red/Rose
)
```

## Dataset Overview

```{r dataset-summary}
summary_tbl <- tibble(
    Dataset = c("Occurrences (Biodiversity)", "Tourism (Domestic Trips)", "Weather (Daily Records)"),
    Records = c(nrow(occurrences), nrow(tourism), nrow(weather)),
    Variables = c(ncol(occurrences), ncol(tourism), ncol(weather)),
    `Time Horizon` = c("2014 – 2024", "2014 – 2022", "2014 – 2024"),
    `Key Entities` = c("4 Organism Groups (Orchid, Finch, Manta, Glowworm)", "445 Regions & 2 Travel Purposes", "11 Primary Weather Stations")
)

summary_tbl %>%
    kbl(caption = "Overview of TidyTuesday Week 31 Datasets", align = "lcccc") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Visualizations

### Visualization 1: Australian Wildlife Occurrences & Weather Network (2014–2024)

```{r viz1-occurrences, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=10.5}
aus_map <- sf::st_as_sf(maps::map("world", "Australia", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))

# Join all occurrences with daily weather observations
occ_w <- occurrences %>%
    filter(!is.na(obs_lat), !is.na(obs_lon), year >= 2014, year <= 2024) %>%
    left_join(
        weather %>% select(ws_id, date, temp, prcp),
        by = c("ws_id", "date")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        year = as.integer(year),
        organism_name = factor(organism_name, levels = c("Orchid", "Gouldian finch", "Manta ray", "Glowworm"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(year, organism_name) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(obs_id = paste0(year, "_", row_number())) %>%
    ungroup()

# Weather station summaries
ws_summary <- weather %>%
    group_by(ws_id, stn_lat, stn_lon) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_rain = sum(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

p1 <- ggplot() +
    # Base map
    geom_sf(data = aus_map, fill = "#F7F7F5", color = "#666666", linewidth = 0.4) +
    # Layer 1: Outlined Organism Observations (all points)
    geom_point(
        data = occ_w,
        aes(
            x = obs_lon,
            y = obs_lat,
            fill = organism_name,
            frame = year,
            ids = obs_id,
            text = paste0(
                "<b>", organism_name, "</b><br>",
                "Date: ", date, "<br>",
                "State: ", ifelse(is.na(obs_state), "Unspecified", obs_state), "<br>",
                "Temp: ", ifelse(is.na(temp), "N/A", paste0(round(temp, 1), "°C")), "<br>",
                "Precipitation: ", ifelse(is.na(prcp), "N/A", paste0(round(prcp, 1), " mm"))
            )
        ),
        shape = 21,
        color = "#222222",
        stroke = 0.35,
        alpha = 0.8,
        size = 2.0
    ) +
    # Layer 2: Weather Stations ON TOP (shape 24 filled triangles with high-contrast white stroke)
    geom_point(
        data = ws_summary,
        aes(
            x = stn_lon,
            y = stn_lat,
            text = paste0(
                "<b>Weather Station: ", ws_id, "</b><br>",
                "Mean Temp: ", round(mean_temp, 1), "°C<br>",
                "Total Precip: ", round(total_rain, 0), " mm"
            )
        ),
        shape = 24,
        fill = "#111111",
        color = "#FFFFFF",
        stroke = 0.25,
        size = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, name = "Organism") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(112, 155), ylim = c(-44, -10), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
        title = "Australian Wildlife Occurrences & Weather Network (2014–2024)",
        x = "Longitude",
        y = "Latitude"
    )

ggplotly(p1, tooltip = "text") %>%
    animation_opts(frame = 900, transition = 0, redraw = TRUE) %>%
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: ", font = list(color = "#333333", size = 14)))
```

### Visualization 2: Australian Regional Tourism Observations by Travel Purpose (2014–2022)

```{r viz2-tourism-map, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=10.5}
# Individual Regional Tourism Observations by Travel Purpose (Business plotted on top of Holiday)
tourism_indiv <- tourism %>%
    filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), !is.na(region), !is.na(purpose), year >= 2014, year <= 2022) %>%
    mutate(
        year = as.integer(year),
        purpose = factor(purpose, levels = c("Holiday", "Business"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(year, purpose) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(obs_id = paste0(year, "_", row_number())) %>%
    ungroup()

p2 <- ggplot() +
    # Base map
    geom_sf(data = aus_map, fill = "#F7F7F5", color = "#666666", linewidth = 0.4) +
    # Individual Regional Tourism Observations split by Purpose (Holiday first, Business on top)
    geom_point(
        data = tourism_indiv,
        aes(
            x = lon,
            y = lat,
            fill = purpose,
            frame = year,
            ids = obs_id,
            text = paste0(
                "<b>Tourism Region: ", region, "</b><br>",
                "Purpose: ", purpose, "<br>",
                "Quarter: Q", quarter, "<br>",
                "Trips: ", round(trips, 1), " Thousand"
            )
        ),
        shape = 21,
        color = "#222222",
        stroke = 0.3,
        alpha = 0.15,
        size = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = purpose_colors, name = "Travel Purpose") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(112, 155), ylim = c(-44, -10), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
        title = "Australian Regional Tourism Observations by Travel Purpose (2014–2022)",
        x = "Longitude",
        y = "Latitude"
    )

ggplotly(p2, tooltip = "text") %>%
    animation_opts(frame = 900, transition = 0, redraw = TRUE) %>%
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: ", font = list(color = "#333333", size = 14)))
```
